capabilities: Suggest frames and groups from an Excalidraw drawing while typing [[filename#
Fuzzy-search and pick frames or groups from a picker
Complete links in Excalidraw block-reference syntax (^frame= / ^group=)
Index vault drawings automatically and rescan on demand
Configure which suggestion types appear and how many
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Both formats are the block-reference syntax already understood by the Excalidraw plugin
problem: Obsidian's link suggestions only reach headings and blocks in Markdown files, so frames and groups inside Excalidraw drawings cannot be linked by name while typing.

relations.evidence: the block-reference syntax already understood by the Excalidraw plugin

summary: Autocomplete plugin that suggests named frames and groups inside Excalidraw drawings while typing [[ links in the editor.
